callees.name: command_argv
callees.pre_condition: command is a non-None value whose argv attribute is a list of strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns the argv attribute of command as a list of strings.

callees.name: command_stdin
callees.pre_condition: command is a non-None value whose stdin attribute is either a string or None.
callees.post_condition: Returns the stdin attribute of command — a string when stdin was supplied, or None when no stdin was provided.
